d: An FBI agent and Florida State officer team up to investigate a string of unsolved murder cases.
A fighter struggling to deal with a tragic loss rescues a Chinese girl being targeted by the Russian mafia.
A detective teams up with an injured female witness to avenge the murders of his partner and an informant.
A young girl from South Los Angeles competes to for a place in the National Spelling Bee.
In 1935, students at historically black Wiley College form a debate team, and go on to defeat Harvard.
